testRecord.businessStateBeforeAfter: Assigned / SangVN / IDTS Bug Report / SAP CAP Backend

expectedResult: Review state becomes IGNORED once; Bug fields, workflow, duplicate links, history, and notifications remain unchanged.
actualResult: The dialog displayed Ignored and disabled all decisions immediately. After browser refresh and reopening, it returned to Pending review with Ignore enabled again. Business fields and workflow remained unchanged.
reviewBoundary: Business non-mutation passed; review-state durability failed and requires DonHV/Jira disposition.

evidence.description: Immediate Ignored state with decisions disabled.
Pending review returned after reload with Ignore enabled.

privacyReview.notes: Controlled Bug and advisory values only.

issueClassification: product defect candidate - ignored AI suggestion can be reviewed again
limitations: The UI exposes no immutable suggestion ID; DonHV must confirm regeneration versus lost review state.
